Look out for the giant boss!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 22 (Formerly, [[Pizza Party|Pizzeria]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Shotgunner''' is a large and high health enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health, decent defense but a slightly slow speed. It also has the [[Stun Immunity]], which makes the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] only slow it down instead of fully stopping it and knockback towers cannot knock it back, and the [[Freeze Immunity]], preventing it from being frozen or chilled. ==Appearance== The '''Shotgunner''' is a robot that resembles the Level 4 Default [[Shotgunner]]. It has dark skin, black mask, torso, sleeves, pants, gloves and harness, grey headset and shoes, shotgun shell bandolier, shotgun shells belt and shotgun shell pouch on arms, and red button knee-pads. It also has yellow button eyes which are popped out of its head, wires protruding from the '''Shotgunner''' and a battery pack on its back. On death, it will shake and flail its arms around, emit yellow sparks, and then power down, with the yellow light on its backpack turning off. It also plays a powering down sound when it dies. ==Strategy== *When dealing with the '''Shotgunner''' when it first debuts, high DPS towers are best. Such towers include the [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]]. **The [[Commander]] should be used to further boost the firerate of these towers. **Do note that the [[Accelerator]] will remain locked onto the '''Shotgunner''' until it is defeated, letting other enemies get past. Other towers should be placed to deal with these enemies when using the [[Accelerator]]. **The [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]] are quite strong against '''Shotgunners''', as their collision and splash damage ignore the '''Shotgunner's''' defense. ***Later on however, stronger splash damage towers such as [[Mortar]] should be used instead of the [[Military Base]] due to '''Shotgunners''' appearing more frequently in later waves with higher health. **The [[Ranger]] can be used, as in addition to dealing high DPS to the '''Shotgunner''', it can counter the [[Balloon Kid]], another enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. **With the [[Lost Souls]] modifier active, your high DPS options are mostly limited to the [[Minigunner]] and [[Golden Minigunner]], which should be used. *It is not recommended to skip a wave until the '''Shotgunner''' is defeated. Otherwise, the enemies from the following wave may overcome your towers while they are still trying to deal with the '''Shotgunner''', with the '''Shotgunner''' acting as a meat shield. *Later on, '''Shotgunners''' will spawn in hordes. Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]], [[Mortar]] or [[Gladiator]] can deal lots of damage to these hordes. **Additionally, most splash damage towers ignore the '''Shotgunner's''' defense, making them even more effective. **Generally, however, these towers are unable to outright defeat hordes of '''Shotgunners''', so high DPS towers should still be used alongside them. *As it has a rather large amount of health and walks quickly, staling towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Warden]] can be useful here, though a lot of them will be less effective because of its immunities. **The [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can only slow down the '''Shotgunner''', instead of fully stopping it. **Freezing towers cannot freeze or chill it, as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. **As it has the [[Stun Immunity]], knockback towers cannot knock it back. *The '''Shotgunner's''' defense can be reduced by defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]]. **Freeze defense dropping towers cannot be used due to the '''Shotgunner's''' [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:PizzaPartyAnimatronicDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Shotgunner''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseShotgunner.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TDSHalloween2022Thumbnail.png|'''Shotgunner''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HalloweenPI1.jpg|'''Shotgunner''' on a promotional image. HalloweenPI6.jpg|'''Shotgunner''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Game Master Ultimate Skin - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Shotgunner''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Halloween 2022 Trailer|'''Shotgunner''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexShotgunner.png|'''Shotgunner''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **'''Shotgunner''' added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **Health increased from 2,000 to 2,500. **Speed slightly increased from 2 to 2.1. **Defense decreased from 40% to 30%. **Now gives {{Money|1,000}} every 50% health lost. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''29 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0]] **Health decreased from 2,500 to 2,250. **Cash given increased from {{Money|1,000}} to {{Money|1,500}} every 50% health lost. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{PizzaParty|[[Citizen Plush]]|Wave 14|Shotgunner|Wave 15|[[Marionette]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Shotgunner}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
